# Evidence ledger (generated by `scripts/evidence_report.py`)

Every important result of Cold Movers, with the kind of evidence it is. A = real SPHEREx measurement; B = injection-recovery test (artificial movers added to copies of real images); C = candidate, not confirmed; D = inconclusive or not detected; S = synthetic or computed check. Catalogue and published values appear only as external comparisons. Built from the files in each row's last column; nothing is typed by hand.

**Confirmed by our own SPHEREx measurements:** 2 motions (Barnard's Star, Epsilon Indi B). Catalogue values are shown only for comparison and are never counted as our measurement.
**Detection rates come only from injected movers:** S/N 15: precision 0.986, recall 0.40 (69 of 173, 1 false confirmation); S/N 30: precision 0.929, recall 0.46. (held-out A)

## Details (source, method, uncertainty, limitations)

- **Motion of Barnard's Star** (A · CONFIRMED). Source: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 images (NASA/IPAC IRSA); one file URL per measurement in data/precomputed/<object>/photometry.csv. Method: catalogue-free search: point sources followed through the visit stacks, straight-line fit, confirmation needs 2+ trusted detectors and combined significance ≥ 5. Uncertainty: ± 0.72″/yr (speed / significance). Limitations: statistical error only; parallax not modelled (bias 0.11″/yr at these dates).
- **Motion of Epsilon Indi B** (A · CONFIRMED). Source: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 images (NASA/IPAC IRSA); one file URL per measurement in data/precomputed/<object>/photometry.csv. Method: catalogue-free search: point sources followed through the visit stacks, straight-line fit, confirmation needs 2+ trusted detectors and combined significance ≥ 5. Uncertainty: ± 0.35″/yr (speed / significance). Limitations: statistical error only; parallax not modelled (bias 0.19″/yr at these dates).
- **Motion of WISE 0855-0714** (C · CANDIDATE). Source: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 images (NASA/IPAC IRSA); one file URL per measurement in data/precomputed/<object>/photometry.csv. Method: catalogue-free search: point sources followed through the visit stacks, straight-line fit, confirmation needs 2+ trusted detectors and combined significance ≥ 5. Uncertainty: ± 1.24″/yr (speed / significance). Limitations: seen in fewer than two trusted detectors; the speed differs from the catalogue by -22 %.
- **Motion of RW Aurigae** (D · NOT DETECTED). Source: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 images (NASA/IPAC IRSA); one file URL per measurement in data/precomputed/<object>/photometry.csv. Method: catalogue-free search: point sources followed through the visit stacks, straight-line fit, confirmation needs 2+ trusted detectors and combined significance ≥ 5. Uncertainty: —. Limitations: below what one year of visits can confirm.
- **Motion of R Draconis** (D · INCONCLUSIVE). Source: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 images (NASA/IPAC IRSA); one file URL per measurement in data/precomputed/<object>/photometry.csv. Method: catalogue-free search: point sources followed through the visit stacks, straight-line fit, confirmation needs 2+ trusted detectors and combined significance ≥ 5. Uncertainty: —. Limitations: no detector can be trusted in this field.
- **Motion of TRAPPIST-1** (D · NOT DETECTED). Source: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 images (NASA/IPAC IRSA); one file URL per measurement in data/precomputed/<object>/photometry.csv. Method: catalogue-free search: point sources followed through the visit stacks, straight-line fit, confirmation needs 2+ trusted detectors and combined significance ≥ 5. Uncertainty: —. Limitations: below what one year of visits can confirm.
- **Temperature of TRAPPIST-1** (A · MEASURED WITH CAVEATS). Source: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 images (NASA/IPAC IRSA); one file URL per measurement in data/precomputed/<object>/photometry.csv. Method: Madhava engine: band-integrated Planck fit, free temperature and scale, traffic light. Uncertainty: Δχ² = max(1, χ²r) interval with an 8 % floor. Limitations: a blackbody-equivalent temperature is not the physical (effective) temperature.

Source: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 images (NASA/IPAC IRSA); one file URL per measurement in data/precomputed/<object>/photometry.csv. Method: the same catalogue-free search over each whole field. Uncertainty: —. Limitations: fields are about 3′ across; this is a negative control, not a survey.
- **Candidates for new, unknown objects** (C · NONE FOUND). Source: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 images (NASA/IPAC IRSA); one file URL per measurement in data/precomputed/<object>/photometry.csv. Method: —. Uncertainty: —. Limitations: only six small fields were searched.
- **Injected movers at S/N 8 (scoreboard campaign)** (B · PARTIAL). Source: artificial movers added to copies of real SPHEREx visit stacks. Method: blind search; matched afterwards. Uncertainty: binomial. Limitations: Gaussian point sources (sigma 0.9 px) added to the frozen visit stacks, same S/N in every detector used; one fake mover at a time, at random quiet spots, in fields where at least four detectors line up well..
- **Injected movers at S/N 15 (scoreboard campaign)** (B · PASS). Source: artificial movers added to copies of real SPHEREx visit stacks. Method: blind search; matched afterwards. Uncertainty: binomial. Limitations: Gaussian point sources (sigma 0.9 px) added to the frozen visit stacks, same S/N in every detector used; one fake mover at a time, at random quiet spots, in fields where at least four detectors line up well..
- **Injected movers at S/N 30 (scoreboard campaign)** (B · PASS). Source: artificial movers added to copies of real SPHEREx visit stacks. Method: blind search; matched afterwards. Uncertainty: binomial. Limitations: Gaussian point sources (sigma 0.9 px) added to the frozen visit stacks, same S/N in every detector used; one fake mover at a time, at random quiet spots, in fields where at least four detectors line up well..
- **Very red injected movers (detectors 5 and 6 only)** (B · FAIL). Source: artificial movers in the two longest-wavelength detectors. Method: blind search. Uncertainty: binomial. Limitations: Diagnosis: a detector is trusted only if its still stars line up between visits. At the longest wavelengths these fields hold only one to three stars. When one of them is a real mover (Epsilon Indi B or WISE 0855 themselves) or the halo of a saturated star (RW Aurigae), the rule distrusts the whole detector, so a second mover cannot be confirmed; in the richer TRAPPIST-1 field most are. Making this rule work in sparse fields is our first next step..
- **Development benchmark (3,300 trials, seed 2026)** (B · REPORTED). Source: artificial movers added to copies of real SPHEREx visit stacks. Method: blind search, matched afterwards; all six detectors, 5–20″/yr. Uncertainty: 95 % Wilson intervals in evidence/VALIDATION_METRICS.md. Limitations: the neighbour-pull rule was chosen on these trials, so these numbers are optimistic.
- **Held-out set A (pre-registered, seed 20261115, same six fields)** (B · REPORTED). Source: artificial movers added to copies of real SPHEREx visit stacks. Method: blind search, matched afterwards; all six detectors, 5–20″/yr. Uncertainty: 95 % Wilson intervals in evidence/VALIDATION_METRICS.md. Limitations: no parameter changed after the run.
- **Held-out set B (pre-registered, new SPHEREx fields)** (B · REPORTED). Source: artificial movers added to copies of real SPHEREx visit stacks. Method: blind search, matched afterwards; all six detectors, 5–20″/yr. Uncertainty: 95 % Wilson intervals in evidence/VALIDATION_METRICS.md. Limitations: two of the four pre-registered fields: in the run that counts, IRSA's search failed for both ecliptic poles. In a repeat run the south pole gave a single visit (no gap longer than 20 days between its images), so no motion can be measured there; a later automatic run reached the north pole (4 visits).
- **Position errors, checked on still stars** (A · MEASURED). Source: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 images (NASA/IPAC IRSA); one file URL per measurement in data/precomputed/<object>/photometry.csv. Method: real-star null test (pre-registered). Uncertainty: —. Limitations: most still stars scatter less than the model says, but a few scatter far more (heavy tails), so single-detector significances are not Gaussian; confirmation needs two detectors for that reason.
- **Motion uncertainties on injections (development)** (B · REPORTED). Source: artificial movers in real SPHEREx stacks. Method: velocity error ÷ quoted uncertainty (pre-registered). Uncertainty: —. Limitations: the quoted blind-search speed uncertainties are too small: read them as at least 1.7 times larger (robust follow-up, not pre-registered), with heavier tails.
- **Motion uncertainties on injections (held-out A)** (B · REPORTED). Source: artificial movers in real SPHEREx stacks. Method: velocity error ÷ quoted uncertainty (pre-registered). Uncertainty: —. Limitations: the quoted blind-search speed uncertainties are too small: read them as at least 1.7 times larger (robust follow-up, not pre-registered), with heavier tails.
- **Temperature intervals on synthetic spectra** (S · REPORTED). Source: computed blackbodies on TRAPPIST-1's real SPHEREx bands and errors. Method: interval coverage (pre-registered). Uncertainty: binomial. Limitations: the interval is quantized to a 0.35 % grid and can be too narrow; for the real objects it is 9 % (TRAPPIST-1) and 7 % (Epsilon Indi B) too narrow; best fits are not biased.
- **Madhava recovers known temperatures** (S · PASS). Source: computed spectra and series (no SPHEREx image). Method: scoreboard rule fixed in advance. Uncertainty: —. Limitations: none noted.
- **Series error stays inside Madhava's guaranteed bound** (S · PASS). Source: computed spectra and series (no SPHEREx image). Method: scoreboard rule fixed in advance. Uncertainty: —. Limitations: none noted.
- **Parallax bias of the straight-line motion fit** (S · REPORTED). Source: catalogue parallaxes and our visit dates. Method: parallax ellipse at each visit date, same fit. Uncertainty: —. Limitations: parallax is not modelled in the fit.
